runtime.kind: WebAssembly, one owned disposable in-memory instance
runtime.postgresql: PostgreSQL 18.3 (PGlite 0.5.8) on wasm32-unknown-emscripten, compiled by emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 3.1.74 (1092ec30a3fb1d46b1782ff1b4db5094d3d06ae5), 32-bit

snippets.label: Bridge update of P7
snippets.sql:
UPDATE products
SET price = 22.00,
    price_hundredths = 2200
WHERE product_id = 'P7';

snippets.label: Convert the stored price in the update
snippets.sql:
UPDATE products
SET price_hundredths = (price * 100)::integer
WHERE product_id = 'P7'
  AND price_hundredths IS DISTINCT FROM (price * 100)::integer
RETURNING product_id, price, price_hundredths;

snippets.label: Condition an external conversion on its source
snippets.sql:
UPDATE products
SET price_hundredths = 2000
WHERE product_id = 'P7'
  AND price = 20.00
  AND price_hundredths IS DISTINCT FROM 2000
RETURNING product_id, price, price_hundredths;
